insights.concise_text: The unsupervised algorithmic methodology addresses the lack of methodologies for summarising NRLS free text by detecting content-based groups from unstructured incident descriptions.

triple.subject: unsupervised algorithmic methodology
triple.object: lack of methodologies for summarising NRLS free text

insights.concise_text: The framework applies Doc2Vec to the 13 million NRLS records and infers vectors for the 3229 St Mary's Hospital records used for clustering.

triple.subject: framework
triple.object: 3229 St Mary's Hospital records

insights.concise_text: Because the NRLS records contain substantial free text and the methodology uses only free and unstructured textual descriptions, the hand-coded structured categories are not required for clustering.

triple.subject: methodology
triple.object: only free and unstructured textual descriptions

insights.concise_text: The 15 externally hand-coded categories used in Doc2Vec benchmarking are the top-level categories of the NRLS two-level manual classification system.

triple.subject: 15 externally hand-coded categories
triple.object: top level of the NRLS two-level manual classification system

insights.concise_text: The claim that training on smaller sets of 1 million records produces good results is supported by benchmarking where reducing the corpus from 13 million to 1 million records did not affect results dramatically.

triple.subject: benchmarking
triple.object: training on smaller sets (1 million) produces good results

insights.concise_text: MST-kNN sparsification addresses weak, redundant edges that obscure the graph structure in the fully connected weighted graph derived from Doc2Vec similarities.

triple.subject: MST-kNN sparsification
triple.object: weak, redundant edges that obscure the graph structure

insights.concise_text: Markov Stability applied to the MST-kNN graph detects subgraphs corresponding to clusters of documents with similar content at different levels of resolution.

triple.subject: Markov Stability applied to the MST-kNN graph
triple.object: clusters of documents with similar content at different levels of resolution

insights.concise_text: The MST-kNN graph with k=13 balances local and global structure and provides computational advantages for the community detection algorithms used by Markov Stability.

triple.subject: MST-kNN graph with k=13
triple.object: community detection algorithms used by Markov Stability

insights.concise_text: Because MS maximisation is NP-hard, the implementation uses Louvain 500 times at each Markov time and selects the best 50 partitions by r(t,H).

triple.subject: NP-hard MS maximisation
triple.object: Louvain 500 times at each Markov time and selection of the best 50 partitions by r(t,H)

insights.concise_text: Robust partitions require both high Markov Stability r(t,H) and persistence across time, indicated by VI(t) dips and VI(t,t') extended plateaus.

triple.subject: robust partitions
triple.object: high Markov Stability r(t,H) and persistence across time

insights.concise_text: The $NMI$ score introduced in Eq. ( 8 ) quantifies the correspondence between MS clusters and the hand-coded external categories reflected by two-layer Sankey diagrams.

triple.subject: the $NMI$ score introduced in Eq. ( 8 )
triple.object: the correspondence between MS clusters and the hand-coded external categories

insights.concise_text: The $\widehat{PMI}$ score evaluates partitions without requiring a labelled ground truth because it is the weighted average of cluster PMI scores computed from corpus word co-occurrence probabilities.

triple.subject: the $\widehat{PMI}$ score
triple.object: no labelled ground truth

insights.concise_text: The $NMI$ used to compare MS partitions against the hand-coded classification is the same score that quantifies correspondence between content clusters and external categories at different resolution levels.

triple.subject: the $NMI$
triple.object: MS partitions against the hand-coded classification

insights.concise_text: The five MS levels examined in detail with word clouds, Sankey diagrams and contingency tables correspond to robust partitions chosen from finer 44 communities to coarser 3 communities.

triple.subject: the five levels of resolution
triple.object: robust partitions from finer 44 communities to coarser 3 communities

insights.concise_text: The quasi-hierarchical organisation revealed by MS analysis is supported by 12-way communities emerging from consistent aggregation of smaller communities in the 44-way partition.

triple.subject: consistent aggregation of smaller communities in the 44-way partition
triple.object: a strong quasi-hierarchical organisation

insights.concise_text: Word clouds made comprehensible through POS tagging, common-verb removal, lemmatisation and 2 or 3-gram frequency lists were used to derive content labels for the 44-community partition.

triple.subject: comprehensible word clouds
triple.object: content labels for the 44-community partition

insights.concise_text: Doc2Vec's reported advantages over BoW in semantic similarity benchmarks are confirmed in this framework by the Doc2Vec version outperforming the BoW version across all resolutions in $NMI$ and $\widehat{PMI}$.

triple.subject: Doc2Vec
triple.object: the BoW version across all resolutions in terms of both $NMI$ and $\widehat{PMI}$ scores

insights.concise_text: Because standard LDA needs a different model trained separately for each pre-determined number of topics, the comparison used five LDA models corresponding to the five MS levels considered in detail.

triple.subject: standard LDA
triple.object: five LDA models corresponding to the five MS levels considered in detail

insights.concise_text: MS obtains partitions at all resolutions in one sweep of the Markov time, while the five LDA models on the same corpus require 30 hours compared with 13 hours in total for the method.

triple.subject: MS
triple.object: the five LDA models on computational cost

insights.concise_text: MS provides improved or equal results to other graph partitioning methods for both $NMI$ and $\widehat{PMI}$ across all scales, except Infomap's slightly improved $NMI$ for very fine resolution with more than 50 clusters.

triple.subject: MS
triple.object: other graph partitioning methods for both $NMI$ and $\widehat{PMI}$ across all scales

insights.concise_text: The method uses paragraph vectors and a content-based similarity graph, and its a posteriori analysis showed good recovery of meaningful categories.

triple.subject: The method using paragraph vectors and a content-based similarity graph
triple.object: good recovery of meaningful categories in a posteriori analysis

insights.concise_text: Because the method captures topics of medical practice, medically-based content clusters such as Labour ward, Pressure ulcer, Chemotherapy and Radiotherapy provide complementary information to externally imposed classification categories.

triple.subject: medically-based content clusters
triple.object: complementary information to the externally imposed classification categories

insights.concise_text: The highly diverse sizes of Level 1 pre-defined classification categories motivate the multi-scale partitioning's additional subcategories with medical detail within some large categories.

triple.subject: highly diverse sizes of Level 1 pre-defined classification categories
triple.object: additional subcategories with medical detail within some large categories

insights.concise_text: The method's discovery of emerging topics or classes of incidents directly from the data addresses the lack of granularity in assigning incidents to a pre-defined category.

triple.subject: the discovery of emerging topics or classes of incidents directly from the data
triple.object: the lack of granularity in assigning incidents to a pre-defined category

insights.concise_text: Because local incident reporting systems require risk managers to improve data quality of reports, free text analytical approaches could free risk managers' time from classification and correction by human operators.

triple.subject: free text analytical approaches
triple.object: risk managers' time from classification and correction by human operators

insights.concise_text: The method uses paragraph vectors, while ongoing work requires dynamically managing the embedding of the reports through updates and recalculation of the vector embedding.

triple.subject: ongoing work on the method using paragraph vectors
triple.object: updates and recalculation of the vector embedding

insights.concise_text: The method obtains an ensuing similarity graph of documents constructed from their content, and improvements in robust graph construction are part of future work.

triple.subject: the content-based similarity graph of documents
triple.object: improvements in robust graph construction
